privacy: Only public documentation and synthetic fixtures were used. No captured customer identifiers or payload values are in this note.

source.section: QA pre-fetch tags, Video tags, both blockedAdTracking examples

accepted_controls: no inferred format or length requirements
open_gaps: Google has not published a complete PCS request contract in the reviewed source.
Cryptographic validity, token expiry, account configuration and accepted impression state are external.
Template completeness does not establish universal requiredness or rejection policy.
The new pack does not claim googleads4 /pcs/click or other Google PCS hosts.

reviewed_sources.observation: Current documented Single Inline Linear and Single Skippable Inline test responses generate securepubads PCS view and pubads PCS click; neither supplies a pagead2 PCS template.

google_existing_and_deferred.decision: No primary pagead2 PCS endpoint contract found in reviewed sources. Matching by parent-domain ownership would overstate scope.

ias_video_pixel.baseline_status: vendor/ias-video-pixel already matches /vevent/ and rejects the exact installation stub with an error
ias_video_pixel.requirement: IAS no longer recommends cachebuster or timestamp macros for external session IDs because event consistency and session uniqueness are not guaranteed.
ias_video_pixel.boundary: Only xsId is checked. Opaque and resolved numeric IDs, genuine session macros, nested URLs, other fields and differently cased parameter names remain unchanged.
open_gaps: Cross-pixel equality and uniqueness require session input, not a single URL.
Extra macro spellings are not guessed from a prefix.

adctv.baseline_status: No pack or directory row; VAST AV bracket tokens receive contextual core.macro.vast_unknown warnings.

official_attribution_chain.observation: Links official studio.adctv.com and Airtory privacy policy.
Public VITE_APP_CDN_URL is https://ads.adctv.com/ and generated embed code loads scripts/src/tag.ins/tag.ins.js.
Sets tracker base https://track.adctv.com. Both sendBeacon and POST fetch producers append event as a query parameter to the root endpoint.

adctv.source_scope_limit: The inspected official script is an embed producer, not a complete tracker endpoint specification. This does not establish a VAST-specific route or mandatory privacy fields.

macro_source.observation: Aniview documents vendor expansion for these names. That does not identify the owner of an arbitrary tracker using them.

adctv.macro_decision: Keep the existing contextual non-IAB macro warning. Expansion capability depends on the producing ad server/player, not solely on the tracker host.

contracts.event: Recommended nonempty opaque event; warning only. Custom event names and extra metadata remain open.
